context_for_next_testing_agent: Document Presentation & E-Signatures feature fully tested. All endpoints working: document upload (PDF, images), list, view/download, presentation toggle, live signing (typed/drawn), public async signing, email sending (MOCKED). Frontend components verified: DocumentPanel, SignaturePad, DocumentViewer, PublicSignPage. WebSocket handlers for document-present, signature-request, document-signed events are implemented.
